question: Which award did former cyclist Sucha Singh receive in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arjuna Award (Lifetime)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Arjuna Award** is one of India's prestigious sports honors, instituted in **1961**, to recognize exceptional achievements in sports and athletics.
 
• It includes a **bronze statue of Arjuna**, a **certificate**, and a **cash prize**. As of recent updates, the cash prize associated with the award is **₹15 lakh**.
 
• The Lifetime category of the Arjuna Award is specifically intended to honor **athletes who have displayed exemplary dedication and achievements over their entire career**, serving as role models for younger generations.
 
• **Sucha Singh**, a former cyclist, received the Arjuna Award under the Lifetime Achievement category in **2025** for his outstanding contribution to Indian cycling and his role in promoting the sport at various levels.
 
• The award recognizes not only the recipient’s sporting achievements but also their efforts in mentoring and uplifting the sport in their region or nation. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Arjuna Award:**

 
 
• The Arjuna Award was established by the Government of India to recognize **exceptional achievements in sports** and to motivate athletes to continue excelling in their respective fields.
 
• Recipients are chosen based on their **performance over the last four years**, consistent excellence, and their contribution to the promotion of sports.
 
• It covers a wide range of sports disciplines, including mainstream sports, indigenous sports, and para-sports.
 
• Famous past recipients include **Sachin Tendulkar, P.V. Sindhu, and Abhinav Bindra**.
 
 
 
• **Eligibility for Lifetime Arjuna Award:**
 
 
• The Lifetime Achievement category is awarded to sportspersons who have **dedicated their lives to sports**, achieving excellence and contributing significantly to the development of their sport.
 
• It is not limited to recent performances but also considers the recipient's **long-term contributions** to the field.
 
• The selection process involves recommendations from a committee appointed by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
 
 
• **Sucha Singh’s Contribution:**
 
 
• **Sucha Singh** is a renowned cyclist who represented India in various national and international competitions.
 
• He played a pivotal role in **popularizing cycling** across different regions, especially in rural parts of the country.
 
• His lifetime dedication to cycling and mentoring young athletes was recognized with the Lifetime Achievement Arjuna Award.
 
 
 
• **Other Sports Awards in India:**
 
 
• **Khel Ratna Award:** The highest sporting honor in India, awarded for outstanding performance at the international level over a period of four years.
 
• **Dronacharya Award:** Given to coaches for their exemplary role in training athletes to achieve excellence in sports.
 
• **MAKA Trophy:** Presented to the best university for sports in India, recognizing the role of educational institutions in promoting sports.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Features of Arjuna Award:**

 
 
• It aims to **encourage athletes** to achieve higher levels of performance and represent India internationally.
 
• The selection process is rigorous, ensuring that only deserving candidates are honored based on **merit** and contribution.
 
• Awardees serve as **ambassadors of Indian sports**, inspiring young athletes to strive for excellence.
 
 
 
• **Historical Context:**
 
 
• The Arjuna Award has been instrumental in **highlighting the significance of sports** as a profession in India.
 
• It has contributed to the **development of sports culture** and recognition of athletes from various socioeconomic backgrounds.
